def_en: 1) to think, plan, esteem, calculate, invent, make a judgment, imagine, count
1b1) to be accounted, be thought, be esteemed
1c1) to think upon, consider, be mindful of
1c2) to think to do, devise, plan
kjv: (make) account (of), conceive, consider, count, cunning (man, work, workman), devise, esteem, find out, forecast, hold, imagine, impute, invent, be like, mean, purpose, reckon(-ing be made), regard, think.
expl: properly, to plait or interpenetrate, i.e. (literally) to weave or (generally) to fabricate; figuratively, to plot or contrive (usually in a malicious sense); hence (from the mental effort) to think, regard, value, compute
